page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.r8ae.2xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server instance running on the KVM hypervisor. It is equipped with 8 dedicated physical cores powered by an AMD EPYC 9T34 processor, operating at a clock speed of 3.4 GHz with 1.0 thread per core. The system configuration includes 64.0 GB of memory, which establishes an 8.0 GB per core ratio. This instance does not include local storage or integrated GPUs, and network connectivity is limited to a baseline bandwidth of 6 Gbps.

Performance benchmarks indicate strong single-core capabilities. The stress-ng single-core CPU test places the instance in the top 10% tier, and the Geekbench single-core score falls within the top 25% tier. Multi-core performance metrics, including stress-ng multi-core and Geekbench multi-core benchmarks, align with the average middle 50% range. Memory bandwidth tests also show average performance, with cached small-block reads at 615.91 GB/sec and uncached large-block reads at 48.71 GB/sec. Cryptographic and vector operations are supported by hardware-level instructions such as AVX-512 and AES.

The 1:8 vCPU-to-RAM ratio positions this instance as a memory-optimized resource, offering high memory density per core. Tradeoffs include the complete lack of local storage, requiring reliance on external block storage, and a baseline network bandwidth of 6 Gbps. Given the dedicated CPU allocation and strong single-core performance, this instance is suited for memory-intensive workloads, database operations, caching layers like Redis, and text processing tasks that do not require local disk storage or GPU acceleration.
